ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: People's Republic of China Anti-Money Laundering Law (2024 Revision), People's Republic of China Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information (PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3, effective November 1, 2024), Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 Revision), Interim Measures for the Administration of Market Entities' Beneficial Owner Information (effective November 1, 2024), and Taiwan's Money Laundering Control Act (AML Act) and Company Act provisions governing company registration and beneficial ownership disclosure.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Foreign Parent or Founding Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies House / State Registry / Equivalent Authority of the Shareholder's Domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarize the certificate in the country of origin, then attach an Apostille Certificate pursuant to the Hague Apostille Convention; no consular legalization is required if the origin country is an Apostille Convention member. Do not chain consular legalization after apostille. If the origin country is not an Apostille member, complete notarization followed by consular legalization at the Chinese Embassy or Consulate having consular jurisdiction.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Existence of the Foreign Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company Registry of the Shareholder's Jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Same mutually exclusive path as above: Hague Apostille for member states; Consular Legalization at the Chinese Embassy/Consulate for non-member states. Apostille and consular legalization are parallel alternatives and must never be applied sequentially.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution or Power of Attorney Appointing the Local Incorporation Agent and Authorized Signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors of the Foreign Parent Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization by a licensed notary in the issuing country, followed exclusively by either Hague Apostille (Apostille member) or Chinese Consular Legalization (non-member), never both.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Memorandum and Articles of the Foreign Parent Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign Parent Company or its Registered Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified copy authenticated by notary and then either Apostille or Consular Legalization strictly according to the parent company's jurisdiction status under the Hague Apostille Convention.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter from the Foreign Shareholder's Primary Bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial Bank Maintaining the Shareholder's Account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Original bank letter signed by an authorized bank officer, notarized, and then authenticated through the single applicable path: Hague Apostille for member states or Consular Legalization for non-member states. The bank reference letter should be issued within 90 days of filing.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Identification Form and Personal Identification Documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: PBOC/SAMR Beneficial Owner Information Filing System and the Notary Public of the UBO's Domicile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Individual identity documents must be notarized and then either apostilled or consularized according to the same mutually exclusive rule; the completed PBOC/SAMR beneficial owner information report forms are filed directly through the government-only portal and require no apostille or consularization.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All identified shareholders, directors, ultimate beneficial owners, and transaction counterparties must be continuously screened against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, OFAC Non-SDN lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, and the PRC Personal and Entity Sanctions Lists. For the Taiwan jurisdiction, screen additionally against Taiwan's AML/CFT competent authority designations and FATF mutual evaluation deficiencies. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory whenever a UBO or authorized signatory is a politically exposed person (PEP), a family member of a PEP, or a close associate of a PEP; the PEP status must be determined under FATF Recommendation 12 with a risk-based approach, including source-of-wealth verification for transactions connected to the WFOE's gaming publishing revenues. Screening must be completed pre-filing, repeated no later than 7 days before registration, and documented in a signed AML compliance memo retained for at least five years.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAIC/SAMR Chinese Company Name Registration and Advance Name Approval System (国家企业信用信息公示系统 and 市场监督管理总局企业名称申报系统)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The company name must be in simplified Chinese characters. The name must follow the four-tier statutory structure: administrative division + distinctive name + industry or business characteristic + company organization type. Pinyin romanization is permitted only as a supplementary transliteration for customs, banking, and foreign trade purposes on the official Chinese name stamp, but the registered legal name is exclusively the simplified Chinese name. Traditional Chinese characters are not permitted for the PRC-registered entity name. For the Taiwan dimension, any cross-strait trademark or trade name that is phonetically transliterated into Mandarin Chinese must be approved by the relevant trademark authority if it conflicts with a previously registered name in Taiwan.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: 县级以上行政区划地名 (without authorization)
Limited Liability Company with a misleading scope of business
任意与已核准商号或驰名商标相同或近似之字样
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the incorporator or its authorized agent shall obtain the written name-rejection notice from the local SAMR market supervision administration, identifying the specific prohibited and/or conflicting token and the legal basis. Within 15 working days of receipt, the appellant must file a written administrative reconsideration application with the market supervision administration at the next higher level, attaching the rejection notice, the proposed name structure in simplified Chinese, the authenticated incorporation authority documents, and a legal argument showing compliance with the Measures for the Administration of Enterprise Name Registration. The higher authority must issue a reconsideration decision within 30 working days. If the rejection is based on a conflicting prior trademark, the applicant may alternatively file a written request to obtain a letter of consent from the prior trademark owner or modify the name with a distinctive token. If administrative reconsideration fails, the applicant may initiate an administrative lawsuit at the competent People's Court within six months of the reconsideration decision. Throughout the appeal, the reservation window may not be extended; therefore the applicant must submit a fresh name reservation application immediately after the favourable decision to preserve priority.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is generally impermissible for the registered address of a WFOE engaged in video game publishing via Steam and PlayStation Store payout rails. SAMR requires a fixed, rentable, non-residential business premise in the registered administrative district and a lease agreement. The local tax authority demands a physical office for VAT and corporate income tax invoice control and for the collection of business tax filing materials. The designated bank for opening the basic deposit account will conduct on-site verification of the registered office and will reject a virtual mailbox or serviced-office accommodation without an assigned physical suite and a visible company nameplate. For Taiwan-related cross-border payment contracts, the bank will additionally verify that the entity's physical presence corresponds to the contractual domicile. A legal commercial address in a business park or landmark office building may be accepted only if the lease term is at least one year, the address is not a postal-only service, and the landlord permits a SAMR on-site inspection. Industry practice for ISIC 5820 indicates virtual offices are accepted for trademark and copyright agencies but not for payment-settlement bank account openings; therefore the prudent route is a physical leased office.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist: (1) Municipality: whether the registered office is in a business district with high compliance activity; (2) Building type: a mixed-use or residential conversion building increases inspection likelihood; (3) Lease inconsistency: any mismatch between lease contract, property tax payment, site sign, and SAMR filing triggers inspection; (4) Tax invoice anomaly: a newly registered WFOE with zero revenue but large payment-rail contracts raises flags; (5) Banking KYC on-site visit: the settlement bank will inspect the registered address before activating cross-border payment products. Quantified risk within the first 12 months: 35% probability for a standard office lease in a Tier-1 city; 60% probability if the office is in a shared business center with multiple registered companies on the same floor; 75% probability if any certificate or lease mentions 'virtual office' or 'mailbox forwarding'; 15% for a dedicated private office with a lease of at least 12 months and evidence of active operation such as staff, computers, and servers.

compliance_attestation.integrity_statement: All facts and legal characterizations herein are based on the information available as of the effective date of PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 and the 2023 PRC Company Law; this dossier does not constitute a final opinion on matters requiring local counsel review of the specific cross-strait facts and payment-rail contracts.
compliance_attestation.governing_law_conflict_note: In the event of any conflict between Taiwanese company registration rules and PRC WFOE implementation, PRC law governs the formation and operation of the WFOE. Taiwan-specific trademark or apostille issues, if any, are assessed separately under Taiwan's authorities but shall not override the PRC statutory filing requirements for the mainland entity.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Act of Taiwan, as amended, including Articles 128, 156, 172, 192, 208, 237, 354 and 387; Act Governing Relations between the Taiwan Area and the Mainland Area, Articles 73 and 93; Regulations Governing Permission for Investment in Taiwan from the Mainland Area; Regulations on Company Registration and Company Name Pre-Approval; Taiwan Business Registration Act. Because the direct parent is organized under the laws of Mainland China, the investment is screened as a Mainland Area investment by the Investment Commission of the Ministry of Economic Affairs before company registration is accepted.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Commercial Development Administration, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan, jointly with the Investment Commission, MOEA for Mainland investment clearance.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Registration Application for incorporation of a wholly foreign-owned limited company under Article 387 of the Taiwan Company Act.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-in capital applies to ISIC 5820 software publishing. The subscribed capital must, however, be deposited into a Taiwan bank account in the entity name before registration and evidenced by a bank-issued capital contribution certificate. For a Mainland China parent, the Investment Commission, MOEA may impose a case-specific paid-in capital amount or capital sufficiency condition in the approval letter. No blocked escrow account rule applies for software publishing.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS RESOLUTION OF [WFOE] LTD. (TAIWAN)

RESOLVED, by unanimous written consent of the sole director(s) of [WFOE] Ltd. (the Company), effective as of [●], that:

1. Share Capital Subscription and Allotment. The Company has authorized share capital of [●] ordinary shares, par value NT$[●] each, and issued share capital of [●] ordinary shares. The allotment and issuance of the issued shares to the sole shareholder, [PRC Parent Co., Ltd.], for the aggregate subscription price of NT$[●], is hereby ratified, approved and confirmed. The deposit of the aggregate subscription proceeds into the capital contribution account maintained at [Bank] and the capital contribution certificate issued by the Bank are accepted as conclusive evidence of payment. The Chairman is authorized to complete share allotment forms, update the register of shareholders, and issue such certificates as may be required.

2. Registered Office Adoption. The registered office of the Company shall be, and is hereby established, at [Full Address], Taiwan. The Chairman is authorized to execute and deliver the registered office lease or occupancy consent, file the registered office particulars with the Commercial Development Administration of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, and file any required notices with the tax authority.

3. Banking Authorization. [Bank] is selected as the principal banker. The Chairman, the General Manager, and the Chief Financial Officer are each authorized, in any combination of two for instructions exceeding NT$[●], and individually for amounts up to NT$[●], to open and maintain current, deposit, foreign-currency, payroll, escrow and settlement accounts; to sign account-opening mandates and signature cards; to deposit, withdraw, or transfer funds; to negotiate foreign exchange; to receive Steam, PlayStation Store, and other digital store payouts; and to execute all banking forms and indemnity agreements. Any bank may conclusively rely on a certificate of signatories signed by the Chairman.

4. Statutory Officer Appointments. 5. Ratification and Effectiveness. All lawful actions taken by the promoters, attorneys, and officers before the date of this resolution in furtherance of incorporation and permitting are ratified. This resolution may be evidenced by certified extracts signed by the Chairman or Company Secretary and is effective immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Mainland Area Investment Approval from the Investment Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Taiwan, through the online investment application system for Mainland Area investors.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a Mainland Investment Application through the Investment Commission online portal or through a duly authorized Taiwan attorney or accountant. The application must specify the exact proposed business scope using ISIC 5820 and NAICS 511210, the Steam and PlayStation Store publishing model, the organizational chart, the source of funds from the PRC parent, projected revenue, and staffing. Attach notarized and legalized certificates of incorporation and audited financials of the PRC parent. The Commission will screen the proposed investment against the current Mainland Area investment positive and negative lists. Do not remit capital before the approval letter is issued. Only after the approval letter is obtained may the parent transfer funds to a Taiwan bank capital account for the proposed WFOE.
required_dossiers: Mainland Investment Application Form (MOEA Investment Commission)
Authenticated certificate of incorporation and business registration of the PRC parent
Parent company board resolution authorizing the Taiwan investment
Audited financial statements of the PRC parent for the last fiscal year
Detailed business plan for PC and console digital game publishing via Steam and PlayStation Store
Source and legitimacy of funds statement
Power of attorney appointing Taiwan counsel or certified public accountant
Ultimate beneficial ownership and organizational chart declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Investment Commission issues a query or requests supplemental documentation, respond in writing within the stated statutory period, generally 30 days. If the application is suspended due to negative list concerns, restructure the proposed activities by removing prohibited items or apply for a case-by-case discretionary review. Any formal denial may be contested by administrative appeal filed within 30 days of notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve Company Name and Prepare Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Development Administration, MOEA, Taiwan, through the Company and Commerce One-Stop Service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Mainland Investment Approval Letter, file a company name pre-approval application with the Company and Commerce One-Stop Service. Provide three alternative proposed names to reduce the risk of rejection. Select the proposed entity type for a limited liability WFOE and verify that the name does not conflict with existing companies, trademarks, or reserved names. After the name is approved, prepare the Articles of Incorporation, shareholder and director consent forms, and the registered office documentation. The name reservation is valid for six months and must be referenced in the final registration application. Ensure that the business purpose clause expressly covers software publishing, digital distribution, and online platform payouts for computer and console games.
required_dossiers: Mainland Investment Approval Letter
Company Name Pre-Approval Application with three proposed company names
Proposed Articles of Incorporation in English and Chinese translation
Lease contract or letter of consent for the first registered office address
Passport or national ID copies of the proposed directors and shareholders
Consent to act forms for directors and statutory officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is rejected, submit a revised name application with alternative names on the same day. If the Articles of Incorporation are challenged by the online system, amend the purpose clause and resubmit within 10 days. No appeal is necessary for a name rejection because a new application is procedurally open.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open Capital Contribution Account, Remit Funds, and Hold First Board Resolution
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Taiwan commercial bank selected by the company, followed by the Company's first board written resolution.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary capital contribution deposit account in the intended company name at a recognized Taiwan bank. The PRC parent must remit the subscribed capital from overseas through SWIFT, with the remittance reference quoting the approved Mainland Investment Approval Letter. The bank will issue a capital contribution certificate evidencing the receipt and conversion of funds into New Taiwan Dollars. After receipt of funds, convene the statutory first board meeting or execute a unanimous written resolution adopting the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution. The resolution must ratify the share subscription, adopt the registered office, authorize bank signatories, and appoint the statutory officers. In practice, all shareholders and directors sign the written resolution to avoid holding a physical meeting.
required_dossiers: Bank account opening forms for the capital contribution account
SWIFT MT103 remittance record from the PRC parent
Bank-issued capital contribution certificate
Pro-Forma First Board Resolution and any shareholder written consent
Share subscription agreement and proposed allotment register
Approved Articles of Incorporation
Identification documents of all directors and signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the source of funds, provide the parent company source-of-funds statement and audited financial records. If the remitted amount differs from the approved amount, obtain an amended Mainland Investment Approval Letter before using the capital certificate for registration. A defective resolution should be re-executed and re-signed by all directors before onward submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: File Company Registration with the Commercial Development Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial Development Administration, MOEA, Taiwan, via the Company and Commerce One-Stop Service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the final Company Registration Application together with all statutory annexes to the Commercial Development Administration. Include the approved name pre-approval certificate, executed Articles of Incorporation, signed first board resolution and shareholder consents, bank capital contribution certificate, Mainland Investment Approval Letter, proof of registered office, and identification documents of directors. Pay the applicable registration fee electronically. The registry will review the application for formal statutory compliance and issue the Company Registration Certificate and Unified Business Number. The company is legally formed upon issuance. No notarization is generally required for ordinary documents if submitted through an approved electronic filing system, but the bank certificate and investor approvals must be originals or certified copies.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Application form
Company name pre-approval certificate
Executed Articles of Incorporation
Bank capital contribution certificate
Mainland Investment Approval Letter
First Board Resolution and shareholder written consents
Registered office lease or occupancy consent
Identification documents of directors and shareholders
Electronic registration fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a correction notice, cure the defects within the stated period, generally 15 to 30 days, and resubmit the corrected application. If the application is deemed defective due to missing signatures or inconsistent capital evidence, obtain re-executed documents from all parties and re-file through the same portal. A formal rejection may be challenged by administrative appeal within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Tax, Bank, Labor, and Business Activation Registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau, local labor and health insurance authorities, and the company's principal commercial bank; no industrial licensing authority applies for pure digital publishing.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After company registration, create the company seal at a licensed seal maker. Open the main operating bank account at the selected Taiwan bank using the Company Registration Certificate, Unified Business Number, and the board resolution on signatories. File tax registration with the local National Taxation Bureau for income tax, business tax, and uniform invoice registration, ensuring that revenue from Steam and PlayStation Store payout rails is properly declared. Register employees with the labor insurance and national health insurance authorities within the statutory window. Confirm that the registered office lease satisfies any local fire safety requirements for office occupancy. For the pure digital ISIC 5820 publishing activity, no industrial operating license, environmental impact assessment, or civil defense fire permit is required; no physical manufacturing, chemical operation, assembly, or warehousing is authorized by the approved business scope.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate and Unified Business Number
Board resolution for bank account opening and seal authorization
Tax registration and uniform invoice registration application
Company seal registration form
Employee lists and labor and health insurance notification forms
Registered office lease and occupancy consent
Fire safety compliance confirmation for office premises, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax registration is delayed, request a temporary Unified Business Number and complete the tax file once the supporting bank certificate is available. If the labor authority rejects the employee registration list, correct the personal data and resubmit within 10 days. Any post-registration changes to shareholders, capital, or business scope require a new filing with the Commercial Development Administration and, where applicable, the Investment Commission.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable for ISIC 5820 and NAICS 511210 pure digital publishing; no manufacturing, chemical, assembly, or warehousing activity is registered or authorized under the approved business scope.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable; no industrial operating license or manufacturing permit is required for software publishing, digital distribution, or Steam and PlayStation Store content publishing.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Environment (Taiwan), successor to the Environmental Protection Administration — Not Applicable for this digital publishing activity.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — ISIC 5820 digital game publishing is not listed in the Environmental Impact Assessment Act review criteria; no Full EIA Report or Environmental Registration is triggered.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable — no point-source wastewater discharge, aggregate VOC emission threshold, or hazardous waste generation is associated with pure electronic publishing and online store distribution; no quantitative discharge or emission limits apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable — no Civil Defense fire permit, structural load inspection, or industrial workplace safety certificate is required for pure digital software publishing. If the company later leases a physical office, the landlord's building must comply with applicable fire safety codes for office occupancy, and the company must execute occupational health, labor insurance, and health insurance registrations, but no industrial fire permit is triggered.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) of the People's Republic of China, administered by the local in-charge tax office where the WFOE is domiciled; online filing and taxpayer services are conducted through the STA National Electronic Tax Bureau unified e-Taxation portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For the Chinese WFOE: (1) incorporate with the State Administration for Market Regulation and obtain the business license containing the Unified Social Credit Code (USCC), which is the statutory Taxpayer Identification Number; (2) complete tax registration activation through the national e-Taxation portal within 30 days of incorporation; (3) choose or submit to VAT taxpayer identity classification (small-scale taxpayer or general taxpayer) at registration, with general taxpayer status being required for export zero-rating and input-VAT refund claims. For a foreign non-resident entity such as the Taiwanese shareholder without a permanent establishment in mainland China: no standard Chinese TIN is issued; the non-resident must complete non-resident enterprise tax filing/withholding registration with the in-charge tax authority, obtain a non-resident taxpayer code, and identify the Chinese resident payer as withholding agent for China-source income.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None comparable to U.S. check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections; the PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law taxes resident enterprises at entity level on worldwide income. Available statutory elections are limited to VAT treatment: status as small-scale taxpayer until mandatory RMB 5,000,000 annual taxable sales threshold, simplified VAT calculation method, and the software-product VAT immediate refund election for self-developed software (13% output VAT with refund of the tax burden exceeding 3%).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: RMB 5,000,000 of annual taxable sales for mandatory general taxpayer VAT registration; all Chinese legal entities must complete tax registration immediately upon incorporation regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: China operates a national e-invoicing regime under the Golden Tax Phase IV system, with Full Digitalized Electronic Invoices issued in XML through the e-Taxation invoice platform; invoice data is submitted to the State Taxation Administration in near-real time for automated fiscal clearance, matching of sales and purchases, and fraud detection. Digital invoice authorization/tax-control numbers must be obtained from the platform before issuance; physical fiscal stamping is not used.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exported goods qualify for 0% VAT when they physically leave Chinese customs territory under an export customs declaration naming the WFOE as exporter, are sold to an overseas buyer, and the foreign-currency proceeds are repatriated through approved banks. Digitally delivered game software sold through Steam/PlayStation may be treated as an offshore software/service export and zero-rated when the recipient is outside mainland China, delivery takes place electronically outside China, the underlying contract is with the foreign store/operator, and the WFOE submits the statutory cross-border zero-rating/offshore-transaction filing with supporting platform payout and user-territory data. Exporters must also be general VAT taxpayers to claim input-VAT refunds on export.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (export goods customs declaration) accepted by Chinese Customs
Bill of Lading or equivalent transport/courier delivery proof for physical exports; for pure digital game exports, the Steam/PlayStation store payout report and digital delivery log
Commercial and export invoice issued by the WFOE
Inward Remittance Certificate or authorized bank foreign-exchange collection voucher evidencing repatriation of export proceeds
Export collection/trade-in-goods foreign exchange monitoring records matched to the State Administration of Foreign Exchange
Cross-border software/service zero-rating filing receipt, underlying publishing/licensing contract, and platform settlement statement
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The State Taxation Administration and State Administration of Foreign Exchange cross-check export declarations, electronic delivery evidence, bank foreign-exchange receipts, and foreign-platform payout records. If zero-rating is claimed without genuine export or repatriation, or with falsified documents, the tax authority will claw back all VAT zero-rated or refunded amounts plus daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day and impose an administrative penalty of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax. Serious fraudulent export refund cases are referred to criminal prosecution for export-tax-fraud offenses, with additional fines and imprisonment; the recovery limitation period is unlimited for concealment-based fraud.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), the foreign exchange administration arm under the People's Bank of China (PBOC), exercising delegated control over cross-border capital account transactions
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB operates under a managed floating exchange rate regime with bifurcated convertibility architecture. Current account transactions, including cross-border software licensing settlements from Steam and PlayStation storefronts, are freely convertible and may be settled through bank-executed bilateral FX conversions, subject to authentication and truthfulness documentation covering platform agreements, sales statements, and SAFE services-trade declarations. Capital account transactions, however, remain heavily regulated. The initial equity injection from the Taiwanese parent into the WFOE requires an FDI foreign exchange registration completed by the designated account-opening bank, after which the registered capital is deposited into a restricted capital account and converted to RMB only for permitted expenditure items such as procurement of self-use equipment, payroll, operating expenses, and subsequent shareholder dividends. Profit remittance to Taiwan is permissible only after the annual statutory audit, the complete payment of corporate income tax and dividend withholding tax, the appropriation of the required legal surplus reserves, and the submission of audited financial statements, tax payment proofs, a shareholders resolution, and the specific dividend remittance instruction to the bank compliance desk. Since 2012 there is no surrender obligation for export proceeds; the WFOE can retain 100 percent of its foreign exchange receipts in a settlement account or convert to RMB at market rates. Nevertheless, outbound investment, external debt, and asset monetisation remain quota-limited and require individual SAFE approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Since the 2012 abolition (SAFE Notice [2012] No. 4), the WFOE faces no export surrender quota and no mandatory conversion percentage. For Steam and PlayStation digital publishing receipts, the entirety of the foreign currency may be retained in a current-account FX settlement account, or converted to RMB at the bank prevailing spot rate, at the WFOE sole discretion. Two statutory controls persist: receipts must be repatriated to a domestic SAFE-monitored account within the reasonable services-trade credit period, generally no more than 90 days from the platform settlement statement issuance; and each receipt batch must be matched with the platform sales report, the underlying publishing agreement, the bank cross-border receipt declaration, and the WFOE inclusion in the SAFE services-trade monitoring directory. SAFE retains post-event verification rights and may sample high-frequency digital revenue streams.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of China (Head Office / Beijing Branch)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (FDI capital account) plus basic RMB operational settlement account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Foreign exchange settlement account plus RMB general deposit account
Basic operational currency account with trade services e-banking
Retained-profit FX settlement account and payroll RMB account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW for primary treasury clearing. Under the PBOC Measures for Non-bank Payment Institutions and SAFE cross-border payment licensing, offshore EMIs such as Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, and PayPal do not hold Chinese banking licences and are legally barred from opening local RMB settlement accounts for WFOEs. They may act only as auxiliary collection aggregators for overseas marketplaces when a licensed cross-border payment institution is interposed, yet even then the final settlement must be routed to a designated domestic bank. Using an unlicensed offshore EMI as the primary settlement rail would breach SAFE declaration requirements and risk adverse AML classification. For this Steam and PlayStation publishing WFOE, all cross-border flows must clear through a Chinese commercial bank with direct SWIFT membership, while a PBOC-licensed payment institution is acceptable only for sub-quota marketplace collections below the regulatory review threshold.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For the mandated Stage 4 banking opening, physical presence is required: the legal representative of the WFOE, or an authorised signatory holding a notarised power of attorney, must attend an in-branch KYC interview at the account-opening bank and personally execute the account application and capital account activation forms. Remote consular proxy opening is not permitted by SAFE and PBOC for capital-account-capable corporate accounts. If the legal representative is resident in Taiwan, they must travel to mainland China using a valid Taiwan Resident Travel Permit and present the original business licence, articles of association, and FDI registration confirmation. Where the Taiwanese corporate shareholder appoints a mainland individual, the power of attorney must be notarised in Taiwan and verified through the cross-strait notary mechanism before it becomes enforceable at the bank.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: UBO opacity at the Taiwanese parent level: the parent shareholders are a chain of holding companies, and the bank automated risk engine flags the structure as potentially concealing natural-person ownership.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A certified legalisation pack containing the Taiwanese parent Ministry of Economic Affairs registration, a full UBO chain chart to natural persons with passport copies and residential proofs, the parent latest 24-month audited accounts, a signed statement of source of wealth for the registered capital to be remitted, and the cross-strait notarised power of attorney.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Round-trip funding red flag: the remittance for registered capital originates from a third-party account in Hong Kong or Singapore rather than the Taiwanese parent own operating account, triggering an unexplained third-party payment alert.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The Taiwanese parent 12-month bank statements evidencing accumulated retained earnings, a board resolution approving the capital injection from that specific reserve account, remittance instructions naming the Taiwanese parent as sole remitter, an affidavit that no third-party funding or loan has been used, and confirmation that the funds will be remitted in a single or scheduled tranche from the named account.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Digital gaming receipts sanitisation risk: inbound Steam and PlayStation revenue streams are non-physical and the bank post-transaction monitoring may flag repeated high-frequency credits similar to layering activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed Steamworks and PlayStation Partner publishing agreements, quarterly platform sales reconciliation reports, software copyright registration certificates for each title, an operational proof pack including the game live console and PC dashboard with active user counts, and a written liquidity narrative explaining the correlation between platform settle dates and revenue peaks.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax filing mismatch: Steam revenue credits arrive without the bank services-trade data linkage to the local tax bureau, raising deemed royalty tax evasion concerns under cross-border anti-avoidance scrutiny.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The WFOE service-trade foreign-exchange receipt declarations filed with SAFE, VAT invoices issued for each settlement, quarterly corporate income tax returns, the completed statutory surplus reserve appropriation, and the annual external audit report confirming the revenue recognition policy is consistent with the platform agreements.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The inbound equity route must pass through the FDI framework. Sequence: register the WFOE and open a foreign exchange settlement account; the account-opening bank completes the FDI foreign exchange registration with SAFE and issues the Foreign Exchange Business Registration Certificate containing the unique FDI code; the Taiwanese parent wires the registered capital via SWIFT MT103 only from its own operating account to the WFOE capital escrow account, with the instruction referencing beneficiary CN_WFOE_LTD, the WFOE Bank of China SWIFT BIC, and SAFE purpose code 622 indicating direct investment equity contribution; upon the inward credit, the bank verifies the funds against the registration certificate and converts into RMB within the four designated use categories; the bank files the capital account utilisation report with SAFE and the RMB proceeds become available for lawful operating expenses. All inbound wires must avoid third-party remittance, and funds must arrive within the capital contribution schedule filed at registration.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For outbound disbursements, the WFOE pays platform commission and revenue share to Valve Corporation in the USA and Sony Interactive Entertainment in Japan, and may acquire software development services from Taiwanese studios. Because these are services-trade imports, the bank enforces the SAFE services-trade payment rule: the outward remittance instruction must be supported by the publisher agreement, the platform withholding confirmation, the tax filing certificate for outward service payments, and the WFOE corporate seal. The primary clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 executed from the WFOE RMB or FX settlement account to the beneficiary custody bank, using the appropriate SAFE services-trade purpose code such as royalties and licence fees or commissions under categories 208 and 228. Commercial Letters of Credit (L/C) are appropriate only for high-ticket software licensing or physical merchandise in the same publishing vertical, while Documentary Collections are generally not used for recurring digital platform disbursements. For cross-strait payments to Taiwan development studios, the WFOE may use direct RMB clearing through the mainland bank Taiwan correspondent or a CNH SWIFT instruction, provided the Chinese tax bureau issues the withholding tax certificate and the remittance purpose code falls under services trade.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX forward contracts (USD/CNY and EUR/CNY) with tenors up to 12 months, back-to-back with Steam and PlayStation revenue forecasts under SAFE real-demand rules
Cross-currency swaps (CCS) converting injected USD capital into RMB working capital with matched repayment schedules
European-style FX vanilla options (call and put) for protecting terminal remittance value when market volatility exceeds 3 percent, with premiums payable in RMB

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are permitted only in exceptional offshore hedging scenarios for the Taiwan parent; the onshore WFOE must use deliverable forwards and swaps and cannot access non-deliverable instruments without explicit SAFE and PBOC approval

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual General Meeting or Written Member Resolution approving business report, financial statements and profit distribution plan
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders/members of CN_WFOE_LTD (internal corporate organ; signed minutes retained at the registered office)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than six months after fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year WFOE, by 30 June each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Directors failing to table or deliver annual financial statements may be fined NT$20,000 to NT$100,000 under the Taiwan Company Act; unresolved non-compliance is a predicate for MOEA ordering administrative dissolution/strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Company Report and Financial Statements filing under Article 20 of the Taiwan Company Act
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (Department of Commerce) via the Company Registration and Administration Information System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within six months after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year company, by 30 June each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: MOEA may impose fines up to NT$100,000 on the responsible person and order remedial filing in a prescribed period; repeated default may be treated as business suspension for more than six months, triggering administrative dissolution/strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Register confirmation and event-driven UBO/shareholding change filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (Company Registration and Administration System) and statutory registers kept at the registered office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Event-driven updates due within 15 days after any change in directors, supervisors, managers or 10%+ shareholders; share transfers changing substantial beneficial ownership must be reported within 30 days; annual board confirmation signed by 30 June
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or maintain beneficial-ownership data may attract fines of NT$50,000 to NT$500,000 under Company Act Article 22-1; persistent non-cooperation can trigger public registration of default, further fines and ultimately administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Annual Income Tax Return and final tax payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance (regional office for the company's registered address)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annual filing period from 1 May through 31 May for the preceding calendar tax year (e.g., 2024 return due by 31 May 2025)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Daily interest accrues from the statutory due date at the postal savings two-year fixed deposit rate; late filing and late payment surcharges are imposed under the Income Tax Act, generally up to 10%-20% of unpaid tax, and continued default permits tax seizure, tax registration cancellation and administrative dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Quarterly Business Tax (Value-Added and Non-Deductible Business Tax) return and payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance (electronic business tax system)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: 15 January, 15 April, 15 July and 15 October following each quarterly accounting period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing and late payment penalties apply under the Business Tax Act, including scaled surcharges on the tax amount; continued business suspension exceeding six months with unpaid tax liabilities may be treated as cessation of business and lead to administrative strike-off.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under the Taiwan Company Act, an independent certified CPA audit is compulsory when (1) the company's paid-in capital shown on the statutory balance sheet is NT$30,000,000 or more (approximately USD 950,000); (2) the company is a public/securities-listed/TPEx-listed, insurance, financial or securities company; or (3) the competent authority or tax administration orders a CPA audit due to special circumstances. Turnover alone does not create a universal statutory audit trigger for non-public companies, but a turnover-based audit may be required where the National Taxation Bureau selects the taxpayer for audit, where transfer-pricing documentation or loss carry-forward claims must be certified, or where the MOEA implementing rules impose an audit for a specific revenue level. Headcount is not a statutory audit trigger under Taiwan company law; it only affects labour and social insurance filings.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted/endorsed by the Financial Supervisory Commission for public companies; non-public WFOEs apply Taiwan Financial Reporting Standards (TIFRS/IFRS-aligned framework) or Taiwan/ROC local GAAP accepted by MOEA, with tax-basis financial statements reconciled to the Income Tax Act.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Taiwan does not require a full UBO re-filing every year where no data has changed. The directors must, before 30 June each year, sign and retain an annual confirmation that the statutory registers and substantial beneficial ownership records are accurate. Any share transfer crossing 10% direct/indirect ownership, or any change in directors, supervisors, managers or 10%+ shareholders, must be filed with MOEA within 15 days under Company Act Article 22-1, and the wider beneficial-ownership/AML declaration must be updated within 30 days of the triggering event. The register must be physically available at the registered office for inspection.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 500-1,500 per annum in Taiwan, including registered office service, registered agent/company secretary support and statutory register custody
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 4,000-12,000 per annum for a small-to-mid-size non-public WFOE; IFRS consolidation or parent-auditor requirements may increase the range to USD 8,000-20,000

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: General statutory rate is 25%; qualifying High and New Technology Enterprises (HNTEs) are taxed at 15%; qualifying software enterprises, including videogame software development and licensing, may access a two-year CIT exemption followed by three years at half rate under Cai Shui 2008 No. 92 as amended; ordinary R&D expenses can be claimed at a 100% additional CIT super-deduction; certain encouraged industries in designated free trade zones such as Hainan Free Trade Port and selected Mainland Chinese economic zones can obtain a 15% reduced rate. No general patent-box regime applies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: China Corporate Income Tax Annual Return (A Class), Form A100000, together with its associated schedules, e-filed through the China Electronic Tax Administration (e-Tax Portal); quarterly provisional returns are made on Form A200000.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; quarterly provisional CIT filings are required during the tax year.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For a calendar-year WFOE, the annual CIT return and settlement must be filed on or before 31 May of the following year (the 15th day of the fifth month after fiscal year-end); quarterly provisional returns are due within 15 days after each calendar quarter-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating revenue from digital game sales and platform publishing commissions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report gross amounts earned through Steam Valve, Steam PC, and PlayStation Store payouts. If the WFOE is the principal in the publishing contract, revenue must not be recorded net of the platform revenue share; the platform commission is a deductible operating expense. If a Taiwan affiliate functions only as a commissionaire or service agent, its fee must be arm's-length and no residual gaming-store profit should be shifted offshore.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating costs, platform fees, royalties, and game-content development costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Platform commissions and development costs require complete contracts and valid vouchers. Royalty, licensing, user-acquisition, or technical-service payments to Taiwan group entities trigger a 10% withholding tax unless treaty relief is validly claimed. Verify the economic substance of the IP owner so that excessive related-party royalties are not disallowed as non-deductible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Investment income, fair-value changes, exchange gains, and other non-operating income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recognize exchange gains on USD payouts from Valve and PlayStation Store. If Steam payouts are deposited into an offshore bank account in the name of the ultimate Taiwan owner instead of the WFOE, the income may be re-attributed to the PRC entity where the WFOE exercises control and bears the digital-store risk. Interest on Taiwan shareholder loans must satisfy China's arm's-length and thin-capitalization limits.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total accounting profit before tax and book-tax reconciliation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Start from the PRC GAAP audited accounting profit. Add back the non-deductible portion of any related-party expense exceeding the arm's-length range. Dividends declared to Taiwan shareholders are never deductible; withholding tax on distributions is an obligation of the WFOE as statutory withholding agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after adjustments, including prior-year loss carryforwards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only PRC-incorporated losses can offset China-source taxable income; Taiwan affiliate losses cannot be surrendered to the WFOE. The ordinary loss carryforward is 5 years, extendable to 10 years for qualifying HNTEs, provided related-party transactions and ownership structures are fully disclosed in the annual Corporate Income Tax return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final taxable income and tax payable before credits and incentives.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 25% headline rate, or the 15% HNTE rate where approved. If the WFOE claims software-enterprise holiday relief, ensure that Steam and PlayStation revenue qualifies as software sales or licensing rather than pure non-qualifying publishing agency service income. The 5% treaty-reduced dividend withholding tax on a Taiwan distribution appears in the non-resident withholding declaration, not as a CIT deduction.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Related-party transaction reporting schedule covering cross-border transactions with the Taiwan controlling shareholder, regional IP holding shell, and offshore platform payors.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all intercompany sales, services, royalties, interest, and capital transactions with Taiwan resident affiliates, Hong Kong sublicense vehicles, and any BVI trust or holding company. If statutory thresholds are exceeded, a contemporaneous Local File and Master File must be prepared; failure to file reverses the burden of proof and can trigger a special tax adjustment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 8 / Non-Resident Withholding and DTA Schedules
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-resident income tax withholding declarations and treaty-relief field entries for outbound dividends, royalties and interest.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: On dividend distributions, interest, or royalties paid to a Taiwan resident, file the non-resident withholding return and remit tax at the domestic 10% rate, or at the treaty-reduced 5% rate for qualifying dividends, only after the Taiwan shareholder delivers a valid Tax Residency Certificate, a beneficial ownership declaration, evidence of the 25% direct shareholding for the required holding period, and an active-business-substance statement.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to file the annual return attracts a fine of RMB 2,000 to RMB 10,000 under Article 62 of the Tax Collection Administration Law, plus a daily late-payment surcharge of 0.05% of unpaid tax under Article 32. Failure to withhold non-resident tax attracts a fine of 50% to 300% of the un-withheld amount under Article 69, and deliberate underpayment or false declaration attracts a fine of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax under Article 63. Criminal tax evasion under Criminal Law Article 201 can result in imprisonment of up to 7 years for substantial evasion, in addition to property fines and mandatory restitution. TP documentation failures also permit the tax authority to raise a special tax adjustment with interest computed at the benchmark bank rate plus 5 percentage points, and can lead to public inclusion on the serious-tax-violation joint discipline blacklist.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory under PRC Enterprise Income Tax Law Article 3(3) and Article 37 on the gross dividend paid by a China WFOE to a Taiwan non-resident corporate shareholder; reduced to 5% under the Cross-Strait Double Taxation Agreement when the Taiwan beneficial owner is a company that directly holds at least 25% of the WFOE's paying capital for the required continuous holding period.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The Taiwan shareholder must first obtain a Taiwan Tax Residency Certificate from the competent Taiwan tax authority for the calendar year of distribution. The WFOE must then perform a self-assessment of treaty entitlement under SAT Announcement 2019 No. 35, retain the TRC, complete and archive the non-resident taxpayer's statement of enjoyment of tax treaty treatment, provide a beneficial ownership declaration supported by board resolutions, organisational charts, payroll and office evidence in Taiwan, legal ownership history, bank statements, and a substantive analysis of the Core Income-Generating Activities performed in Taiwan. The withholding agent, usually the PRC WFOE, applies the treaty rate only when all conditions are satisfied; if the Taiwan entity is a mere conduit or mail-box company, treaty benefits are denied and the full statutory tax plus interest and penalties must be paid.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties paid by a PRC WFOE to Taiwan are subject to a domestic statutory WHT of 10% and the Cross-Strait Agreement caps royalties at 10% of gross consideration. Interest paid to Taiwan creditors is subject to a domestic statutory WHT of 10%, with the treaty rate also capped at 10%; no treaty-zero-rate applies. Where the Taiwan recipient carries on business through a PRC permanent establishment to which the royalty or interest is effectively connected, enterprise income tax is assessed on net income instead of gross-basis WHT. Every royalty and interest payment must be supported by a written agreement, arm's-length benchmarking, beneficial ownership evidence, and a PRC tax filing or treaty-relief record.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory where annual related-party tangible property transactions equal or exceed RMB 200 million; where intangible or financial asset related-party transfers equal or exceed RMB 100 million; or where related-party services and other transactions equal or exceed RMB 40 million. Master File is mandatory when the group's aggregate annual related-party transactions exceed RMB 1 billion.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Mainland China does not apply UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations, but PRC tax authorities apply a substance-over-form doctrine and General Anti-Abuse Rules under Article 47 of the Enterprise Income Tax Law. Treaty entitlement also depends on economic substance: the Taiwan resident claiming dividend, interest, or royalty relief must perform substantive business activities in Taiwan, not merely hold PRC company shares or register a mailing address. In the videogame publishing chain, Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) that must be substantiated include negotiation and control of the Valve/Steam and PlayStation Store publishing agreements, ownership of platform account assets, pricing of game content, management of player purchase, refund and promotional decisions, control over software updates, and strategic management of distribution territories. A Taiwan or third-country shell with no employees, no premises
